# 引擎选择与费用争议知识图谱

## 引擎费用全景
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Unity["Unity (免费下载安装)"]
    UnityFee["安装费（约 1‑2¢/次）"]
    UnityPolicy["政策追溯至已发布游戏"]
    UnityControversy["社区强烈反感"]
    Unreal["Unreal Engine 5 (免费下载安装)"]
    UnrealFee["收入超过 $1M 后收取版税"]
    Godot["Godot (开源、完全免费)"]
    GodotFeatures["体积小 (~80 MB)、强大 2D 工具"]
    Comparison["费用模式对比"]
    Outcome["向免费引擎转移的趋势"]

    Unity --> UnityFee
    UnityFee --> UnityControversy
    Unity --> UnityPolicy
    UnityPolicy --> UnityControversy
    Unity --> Comparison
    Unreal --> Comparison
    Godot --> Comparison
    Comparison --> Outcome
    Unreal --> UnrealFee
    UnrealFee --> Outcome
    Godot --> GodotFeatures
    GodotFeatures --> Outcome
```

## 引擎选择决策流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start["独立开发者决定使用哪款引擎"]
    CostConcern["对成本敏感"]
    FeatureNeed["需求：2D 还是 3D"]
    CommunitySupport["社区与教程支持"]
    LicensePreference["倾向开源许可证"]
    UnityOption["选择 Unity"]
    UnrealOption["选择 Unreal"]
    GodotOption["选择 Godot"]
    SuccessRisk["潜在费用风险"]
    SuccessBenefit["可能的成本节约"]
    End["最终确定的引擎"]

    Start --> CostConcern
    Start --> FeatureNeed
    CostConcern --> UnityOption
    CostConcern --> UnrealOption
    CostConcern --> GodotOption
    FeatureNeed --> UnityOption
    FeatureNeed --> UnrealOption
    FeatureNeed --> GodotOption
